THE SUBJECT AND ALL COMPARABLES ARE LOCATED WITHIN THE SAME NEIGHBORHOOD. THE SUBJECT AND ALL COMPARABLES ARE CONSIDERED TO BE MOSTLY SIMILAR IN AGE, DESIGN AND QUALITY OF CONSTRUCTION. ALL OF THE SALES COMPARABLES TRANSFERRED WITHIN THE PAST SIX MONTHS, WHICH DEMONSTRATES RECENT VALUES IN PROXIMITY TO THE SUBJECT.
ALL ADJUSTMENTS WERE MADE USING THE PAIRED SALES ANALYSIS METHOD. AS COMPARED TO THE SUBJECT, PERTINENT ADJUSTMENTS WERE MADE TO THE COMPARABLES FOR NOTABLE DIFFERENCES IN LIVING AREA AND AMENITIES. SELLER CONCESSIONS FOR THIS MARKET WERE WITHIN THE TYPICAL RANGE OF 0 - 6% SO NO ADJUSTMENTS WERE MADE. THE SUBJECT DOES NOT HAVE A GROUND RENT. ANY COMPARABLES WITH A GROUND RENT WERE ADJUSTED WITH A 6% CAP RATE ACCORDING TO HUD GUIDELINES. SOME LOT SIZES MAY DIFFER BY MORE THAN 20% AND ADJUSTMENTS WERE GIVEN BASED ON ESTIMATED MARKET VALUE AND MARKETABILITY FOR SITE UTILITY LIKE THE SUBJECT. ALL SALES COMPS ARE CONSIDERED TO BE SIMILAR TO THE SUBJECT IN CONDITION AND INTERIOR FINISHES SO NO ADJUSTMENTS WERE MADE. SOME SALES REQUIRED ADJUSTMENT FOR DIFFERENCES IN BASEMENT ROOM COUNT, WHICH WERE ADJUSTED ACCORDINGLY. ANY DIFFERENCES IN BEDROOM COUNTS ARE INCLUDED IN THE GROSS LIVING AREA ADJUSTMENTS. TOTAL SQUARE FOOTAGE WAS ADJUSTED AT $50/SF BASED ON THE PAIRED SALES ANALYSIS AND OTHER ELEMENTS OF COMPARISON INCLUDING BUYERS ACTIONS. THIS ADJUSTMENT ONLY APPLIES WHEN THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN THE SUBJECT AND THE COMPS GROSS LIVING AREA EXCEEDS 100 SQUARE FEET. YOUR APPRAISER IS AWARE THAT ACROSS THE BOARD ADJUSTMENTS WERE REQUIRED FOR NUMEROUS PROPERTY FEATURES. ALTHOUGH NUMEROUS ADJUSTMENTS WERE REQUIRED FOR SOME COMPS, THESE ARE THE BEST SALES TO DEMONSTRATE AND SUPPORT THE SUBJECT'S VALUE. YOUR APPRAISER IS AWARE THAT SOME SALES COMPARABLES MAY VARY IN AGE AND GROSS LIVING AREA BY MORE THAN 30% AND SOME LINE, NET AND GROSS ADJUSTMENTS MAY EXCEED THE RECOMMENDED RANGE. THIS IS TYPICAL FOR PROPERTIES THAT REQUIRE NUMEROUS ADJUSTMENTS IN THIS MARKET. AFTER ALL ADJUSTMENTS, THE SALES FALL INTO A VALUE RANGE APPROPRIATE FOR THE SUBJECT.
